title: Negative-question replies with singular owners
focus: To confirm that someone does have the thing, answer On. To say they do not have it, answer Ei ole.
prerequisiteSkills: Fixed eikö ole in possession questions

exercises.prompt: Reply to “Eikö sinulla ole koiraa?” with “You do not have it.” Choose a verb reply. koira means “dog”. Address one person.
exercises.explanation: Answer the stated possession meaning: On confirms having it; Ei ole denies having it. Both remain fixed with every owner. An optional Kyllä or Ei can introduce the reply.
requiredSkills: Fixed eikö ole in possession questions
Negative possession question short answers
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Negative possession question short answers: form or meaning confused

sentenceExplanation.pattern: fixed possession verb reply; owner and thing understood from the question

parts.formation: Keep fixed ei in the negative possession reply.
Ei ole denies possession; it remains fixed for every owner.

answerDiagnostics.category: Negative possession question short answers: predictable form error
answerDiagnostics.explanation: Olen and en ole describe “I am” and “I am not”. A possession reply echoes fixed on or ei ole.

Answer the stated possession meaning: On confirms having it; Ei ole denies having it. Both remain fixed with every owner. An optional Kyllä or Ei can introduce the reply.
This gives the opposite of the requested possession meaning.
This is a personal “I am” reply; possession echoes fixed on or ei ole.

exercises.prompt: Complete “He does have it.” after “Eikö hänellä ole autoa?”: “Kyllä, ___.” auto means “car”.
exercises.explanation: Kyllä means “yes”. Fill the gap with fixed on (“do have it”); the possession reply stays the same for every owner.
requiredSkills: Fixed eikö ole in possession questions
